The Authority had issued Regulations on Re-insurance, Foreign Re-insurance Branches (FRBs) and Lloyd' India. Subsequent to the issue of these regulations, the Insurers have made representations through the General Insurance Council for clarifications, applicability of certain provisions of the Regulations / Guidelines / Circulars as would be applicable to Indian Re-insurers, FRBs and Lloyd's India. 2.
